verdict.rationale: Defining infrastructure in code is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Terraform as using 'human-readable configuration files', and a community user calls it a 'half-baked language' and contrasts it with Pulumi. Nothing in the pack shows a general-purpose programming language option (e.g. a CDK-style SDK) with types, loops and IDE support.
